name: dimcode
description: A coding agent that puts leading models at your command.
setup: npx -y dimcode@0.5.6 provider add probe --adapter openai --base-url ${MOCK_LLM_URL} --model probe-model --api-key probe-mock-key
npx -y dimcode@0.5.6 provider switch probe --model probe-model

probeProfiles.description: DimCode offered option: workspace reads/writes, git commands, and approval for other process/network access.
DimCode offered option: tool access without approval prompts. Only controlled no-op/read/write stimuli in the temporary probe workspace.

notes: Pinned CLI custom provider with the openai adapter. Setup must succeed before ACP launches. DIMCODE_HOME isolates credentials and provider state in the probe workspace.
